flags.why: The entry omits the common colloquial adjective meaning resentful or annoyed after being slighted or thwarted ([dictionary](https://tudientv.com/?t=c%C3%BA)).
flags.fix: Add: adj [colloquial] | resentful; annoyed (after being slighted or thwarted).

flags.why: This verb is regional Central Vietnamese usage, documented in the [Huế dialect dictionary](https://download.thuthuatphanmem.vn/uploads/2022/09/27/khotudientienghue_100441.pdf), rather than an unmarked nationwide expression.
Calling someone ngu ngốc is derogatory and can offend them, but the sense has no warning tag.
